trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api was rolled back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Verified post-rollback health: all regions healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. The summary describes the failure, the rollback action, the restored health, and notes that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains under investigation.

Note: the first incident creation attempt timed out; the retry with an idempotency key succeeded without creating a duplicate.
